matches.xml: <field id="companyDesc" name="Company Introduction" type="input"><rules><rule name="valueTypeRule" value="text" /></rules><value>Quanzhou Beiqiang Footwear & Apparel Co., Ltd. is a footwear factory supplier based in Quanzhou, Fujian, China. We serve importers, wholesalers, online sellers and private-label buyers with casual walking shoes and related footwear. Sample review, mixed size and color requirements, and OEM/ODM options can be discussed according to product availability, quantity, materials, logo and packing requirements. Product details and delivery arrangements are confirmed before order placement.</value></field>

Before delivery, we will check the products according to order requirements to help reduce quality risks for customers.</value></field></complex-values><complex-values><field id="question" type="input"><value>Are you a trading company or a manufacturer?</value></field><field id="answers" type="input"><value>We are a manufacturer.</value></field></complex-values><complex-values><field id="question" type="input"><value>Why should you buy from us not from other suppliers?</value></field><field id="answers" type="input"><value>We specialize in casual and sport-casual footwear, especially slip-on sneakers and lightweight knit shoes.
